workspace_users_player_link_check.name: workspace_users_player_link_check
workspace_users_player_link_check.value: ("workspace_users"."player_uid" is null) = ("workspace_users"."player_link" is null) and ("workspace_users"."player_link" is null or "workspace_users"."player_link" in ('approved', 'pending'))

calendar_occurrences_second_check.name: calendar_occurrences_second_check
calendar_occurrences_second_check.value: ("calendar_occurrences"."second_kind" is null) = ("calendar_occurrences"."second_uid" is null) and ("calendar_occurrences"."second_uid" is null) = ("calendar_occurrences"."second_name" is null) and ("calendar_occurrences"."second_kind" is null or "calendar_occurrences"."second_kind" in ('vip', 'guardian'))

calendar_occurrences_two_people_check.name: calendar_occurrences_two_people_check
calendar_occurrences_two_people_check.value: "calendar_occurrences"."coach_uid" is null or "calendar_occurrences"."second_uid" is null or "calendar_occurrences"."coach_uid" <> "calendar_occurrences"."second_uid"

roll_calls_added_unique.name: roll_calls_added_unique
roll_calls_added_unique.where: "roll_calls"."request_id" is not null and "roll_calls"."deleted_at" is null
